_meanings:
.²1 Following in praise; speech.
.²2 Sarasvatī.
.²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of metres consisting of four Pādas of 8 syllables each,
 the whole stanza consisting of 32 syllables (so called because it follows
 with its praise {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} {#anuzwoBati#} the Gāyatrī, which has 3 Pādas),
 {#anuzwoBanAdanuzwup#}. In later metrical systems it stands as a general
 name for all metres which have 8 syllables in each foot (the highest possible
 number being computed to be 256); {#paYcamaM laGu sarvatra saptamaM dvicaturTayoH .#}
 {#guru zazWaM ca pAdAnAM Sezezvaniyamo mataH ..#} which rule is sometimes
 violated. {#anuzwuBA soma ukTErmahasvAn#} <ls>Rv. 10. 130. 4</ls>.
